questions.question:
A copper rod AB of length l is rotated about end A with a constant angular velocity . The electric field at a distance x from the axis of rotation is
a) $\frac{mω^{2}x}{e}$ 		b)$\frac{mωx}{el}$
c) $\frac{mx}{ω^{2}l}$
d) $\frac{me}{ω^{2}x}$
